items.title: 트럼프 “후티, 홍해 봉쇄하면 우리가 처리…이란 ‘곡괭이산’도 곧 타격” - 한겨레

summaries.en: President Trump warned of strong action if Yemen's Houthi rebels blockade the Red Sea and threatened to strike Iran's 'Pickaxe Mountain' facility, suspected of housing uranium enrichment centrifuges.
summaries.zh: 特朗普总统警告称，如果也门胡塞武装封锁红海将采取强硬行动，并威胁打击伊朗被怀疑存放铀浓缩离心机的“镐山”设施。
